## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link a related issue if available.

## Verification

List checks performed and their outcomes. Mark anything unverified, including platform limitations. For UI changes, include app-only screenshots with generated demo data.

## Review

- [ ] The change is focused and relevant documentation is updated.
- [ ] File privacy, selected-folder containment and safe trash behavior are preserved.
- [ ] No secrets, personal files, generated caches or build outputs are included.
- [ ] Third-party attribution/license requirements are satisfied where applicable.
